te: Business sector heard on restructuring the Social Security Office
se: The meeting considered restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office, inviting representatives of the Thai Chamber of Commerce and Board of Trade of Thailand, the Federation of Thai Industries and experts to give their views from the employers' side
it: Restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office

te: Study of restructuring the Social Security Office (continued)
se: The meeting continued to consider restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office, hearing the views of the agencies concerned, including representatives of employers and of insured persons
it: Restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office

te: Study of restructuring the Social Security Office (continued)
se: The meeting continued to consider restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office, hearing information from fiscal and public administration agencies, for use in preparing its recommendations
it: Restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office

te: State agencies heard on restructuring the Social Security Office
se: The meeting continued to consider restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office, inviting representatives of the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council and other agencies concerned to give information and views on a suitable form of organisation
it: Restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office

te: Study begins on restructuring the Social Security Office
se: The meeting began to consider restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office, so that the Social Security Fund is managed efficiently and transparently and serves insured persons better, inviting the agencies concerned to give information
it: Restructuring the organisation of the Social Security Office

te: Social Security Office explains the draft regulation on electing board members
se: A representative of the Social Security Office explained the key points of the draft Ministry of Labour Regulation on the rules and procedures for electing employer representatives and insured person representatives as members of the Social Security Board, including lessons from the election of Social Security Board members on 24 December 2023, for use in the meeting's consideration of its recommendations
it: Draft Ministry of Labour Regulation on the rules and procedures for electing employer representatives and insured person representatives as members of the Social Security Board

te: Draft election regulation and a petition considered
se: The meeting considered the draft Ministry of Labour Regulation on the rules and procedures for electing employer representatives and insured person representatives as members of the Social Security Board. The Social Security Office asked to give its explanation at the next meeting instead. The meeting also considered a petition proposing that Social Security Board members continue to be elected directly on a one person, one vote basis, and approved the summary of its consideration of the matter
it: Draft Ministry of Labour Regulation on the rules and procedures for electing employer representatives and insured person representatives as members of the Social Security Board
Petition asking to keep direct elections on a one person, one vote basis

se: The meeting considered an approach to electing Social Security Board members known as the "Justice Distribution Model", which proposes that representatives on the board reflect the different groups of insured persons more widely, for use in considering the draft election regulation
it: The "Justice Distribution" model for electing Social Security Board members

te: Draft regulation on electing Social Security Board members discussed
se: The meeting discussed observations on the election of employer and insured person representatives to the Social Security Board, which oversees a large fund belonging to insured persons across the country, and followed up the public hearing on the draft Ministry of Labour Regulation on the rules and procedures for electing employer representatives and insured person representatives as members of the Social Security Board, held from 15 January to 14 February 2026
it: Observations on the election of Social Security Board members

te: The new old-age pension formula (the CARE formula) discussed
se: The meeting continued to consider the change to the formula for calculating the old-age pensions of insured persons under sections 33 and 39, known as the CARE formula, expected to come into use in mid-2026. The meeting felt the formula is fair and benefits most insured persons, but those who paid low contributions for a long time and raised them near retirement may receive a lower pension, so there should be measures for the transition period and thorough communication so that insured persons understand
it: Change to the old-age pension formula (the CARE formula)

it: Draft Home Workers Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. .... (Senate Rules of Procedure, rule 119)

se: The meeting studied the principles, reasons and key points of the draft Home Workers Protection Act (No. ..) B.E. .... under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure B.E. 2562 (2019)
